payload.posture: Read Haggai 2:20–23 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the oracle names shaking, overturned thrones, broken military strength, and Zerubbabel as a signet. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
